mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without threshold requirements.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to earnings contraction fears.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: 20-day returns positive in >55% of cases, or interaction term p>0.05 in 3-year regressions.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days due to supply chain disruption and earnings pressure.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns positive in >55% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) above 12-month moving average indicates strong consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns negative in >55% of HOUST > 12mo MA periods, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPI year-over-year growth exceeding 3.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns positive in >45% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent payroll decline (PAYEMS) and unemployment rise (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days via recession risk.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS decline/UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns: 5-day returns positive in >55% of cases, or interaction term p>0.05 in 3-year regressions.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP contraction (GDPC1 QoQ < 0.0%) signals demand weakness, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days through earnings headwinds.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns positive in >55% of GDPC1 QoQ < 0.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
